title: introduce-autoscale-telemetry-gate-and-quant-profile-lifecycle
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds telemetry gating for autoscale-driven cost simulations and a lifecycle for quantization profiles. Backwards-compatible storage migration included.
commits: 3 commits: 1) add telemetry gating framework + config and CLI hooks; 2) implement quant-profile lifecycle and migration; 3) test fixes and docs for rw cost-sim
changed_files: high-level: services/econ/autoscale_controller.go, services/econ/telemetry_gate.go, tools/cli/cost_sim.go, models/quant/profile_store.go, migrations/20260301_quant_profile_migration.sql, docs/ops/cost-telemetry-gating.md, tests/econ/telemetry_gate_test.go, tests/quant/profile_lifecycle_test.go, internal/metrics/telemetry_schema.yaml
description:
Context and motivation:
This PR implements a conservative telemetry gating mechanism for autoscale-driven cost workflows plus a managed lifecycle for quantization profiles. Our goal is to reduce noisy/expensive attempts to run full tenant cost simulations when upstream telemetry shows negligible unit-econ improvements and to provide a safe path for quant profile promotion/retirement across Dedicated and Private deployments. The work responds to ENG-4217 (reduce wasted autoscale sim runs) and ENG-4299 (make quant profile lifecycle explicit).

What changed (single continuous description):
- Telemetry gate: new lightweight filter that examines the recent unit-econ stream (token-level latency, per-token cost, cache hit ratios) and decides whether a full simulation run should be scheduled. Gate lives under services/econ/telemetry_gate.go and exposes a minimal API used by autoscale_controller. Gate decision respects a new config key telemetry.gating.enabled (default true) and a tenant override. Gate uses heuristics + a short simulated micro-eval to estimate probable ROI before scheduling heavy work.
- Quant profile lifecycle: add profile states (candidate, promoted, deprecated) and a background reconciler that safely rolls forward promotions only after passing stability checks. Implementation in models/quant/profile_store.go plus a DB migration to add state columns (migrations/20260301_quant_profile_migration.sql).
- CLI and ops: new CLI command rw cost-sim run --dry-run and rw cost-sim promote-profile to experiment with gating behavior without committing changes. Docs added at docs/ops/cost-telemetry-gating.md.
- Observability and safety: telemetry schema extended (internal/metrics/telemetry_schema.yaml) and new histograms + slog lines to trace gate decisions. Gate emits reasons for skip vs schedule to make postmortems easier.
- Tests: unit tests for gating heuristics and profile lifecycle (tests/econ/telemetry_gate_test.go, tests/quant/profile_lifecycle_test.go) and an integration smoke test for the CLI.

Files changed summary:
- services/econ/autoscale_controller.go: wire in gating decisions before enqueuing large simulations; add safe fallback path when gate fails-open in test mode. (~+120/-14)
- services/econ/telemetry_gate.go: new file; implements policy engine and micro-prober. (~+260)
- models/quant/profile_store.go: add lifecycle state and promotion/rollback helpers. (~+140/-6)
- migrations/20260301_quant_profile_migration.sql: migration to add profile_state, promoted_at, retired_at. (~+34)
- tools/cli/cost_sim.go: new CLI surface for ops and SRE. (~+90)
- docs/ops/cost-telemetry-gating.md: operational runbook and troubleshooting. (~+40)
- tests/*: added test files and fixtures. (~+48/-108)

Review conversation summary (high level, single string):
- Miguel: requested a clearer separation between tenant-level overrides and global gating flags; asked for audit events when a profile is auto-promoted.
- Author (Aisha): implemented tenant override precedence and added an audit event emission in profile_store.go; pushed a small follow-up commit and noted migration considerations for private installs.
- Tess: asked for a unit-econ simulation stub to avoid flaky integrations; author added a local deterministic micro-prober used by gating heuristics to reduce CI variability.
- Connor: called out logging volume risk for high-throughput tenants; author added rate-limiting on gate rationale events and documented expected logs in docs.
- Approvals: Miguel and Tess approved after follow-ups; Connor approved pending a small lint cleanup that was addressed.

CI and stability notes:
- Initial CI run failed on one flaky test (tests/econ/telemetry_gate_test.go) due to timing assumptions; replaced timing with deterministic probes and re-ran. Final CI status: pass across unit+smoke suites. Performance hammer tests (perf-canary) were run as a follow-up job in staging and showed a median reduction of 18% in scheduled full-sim jobs for tenants with low-change windows.

Migration and rollout plan:
- DB migration is backward-compatible: profile_state defaults to 'candidate' and the reconciler only touches profiles that have explicit candidate markers. Ops: run migration during maintenance window; feature gate can be toggled with telemetry.gating.enabled=false while backfilling.
- Safe rollout: default-on for new tenants, opt-in for existing via tenant flag. We will enable for 10% of tenants via release toggles for two weeks and monitor the gate_decision.{skipped,schedule} metrics and profile_promotion.{attempt,succeed,rollback}.

Why this is different from earlier cost/autotune PRs:
- Rather than changing batching/quant heuristics directly, this PR introduces a lightweight pre-filter that prevents expensive downstream work unless telemetry indicates potential unit-econ improvement. It complements, not replaces, the autotuners and batchers. The quant profile lifecycle element clarifies promotion/retirement semantics so that ops can reason about automated promotions initiated from autotuners.

Testing performed:
- Unit tests for heuristics and profile transitions (deterministic micro-prober).
- CLI smoke tests in CI and a staging run against a 50-tenant synthetic workload.
- Perf canary job to validate that gate reduces unnecessary simulation load.

Follow-ups / TODOs captured in ENG-4217:
- Add a simulation-cost estimator to the gate to quantify expected token-cost savings per run.
- Expose per-tenant gate tuning via Console (UX/Frontend work).

Merge outcome: Squash-merged to main on 2026-03-02 after approvals and CI green. Migration SQL included in the merge commit.

Notes for on-call and SRE:
- If unexpected profile promotions occur, toggle telemetry.gating.enabled=false and run rw cost-sim promote-profile --dry-run to inspect candidates. Gate rationale metrics: telemetry_gate.rationale (labels: tenant, reason).

This description and checklist are intentionally compact to keep the PR focused; full operational guidance is in docs/ops/cost-telemetry-gating.md.
notes: Feature default: enabled for new tenants; opt-in rollout plan for existing customers. Observability and audit trails included.
